function: DDPG jointly learns RSU transmit beamforming and IRS phase shifts to maximize the minimum V-UE rate (max-min fairness) in an IRS-assisted MU-MISO V2X downlink (pp. 1-2).
system: IRS-assisted MU-MISO downlink V2X: RSU with M=4 antennas, K=4 single-antenna V-UEs, reflecting IRS with N=20 or 30 elements, direct link blocked; band not stated (pp. 1, 3-4).
method: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DVIRA): actor-critic with target networks and replay buffer; reinforcement learning by interaction with the environment, E=500 episodes of T=60000 steps (pp. 2-3).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician RSU-IRS and IRS-user links (Rice factor 10, Rayleigh NLoS, path-loss exponents 2 and 2.2), fixed distances; no standard model or dataset (pp. 1-3).
test_conditions: Single simulated setting (M=4, K=4, fixed distances); sweeps over RSU power 10-35 dBm and N=20 or 30, trained under different powers; no unseen scenario (pp. 3-4).
baselines: Non-learned: random IRS and MRT beamforming [10]. No earlier learned method or other learning algorithm compared (p. 3).
metrics: Minimum V-UE rate (bps/Hz) versus RSU transmit power for N=20 and 30; per-V-UE rate for fairness; instantaneous and average reward versus steps (pp. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 1: "Rician fading, represented as:" (Rice factors of 10 and path-loss exponents 2 and 2.2 on p. 2); own simulator, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 3: "different RSU transmit power constraints and varying numbers" of IRS elements are swept; the paper never says that a model trained for one configuration is tested on another, nor reports transfer or fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 3: "random IRS and MRT beamforming strategies [10]" are the only baselines (non-learned); no earlier learned method or other learning algorithm is compared with the proposed DDPG.
q4_support: p. 3: "of the algorithm are as follows: maximum episodes E=500," only training hyper-parameters are given; no order of complexity, operations, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 3: "In this section, we validate the performance of the proposed" algorithm by simulation with its own Rician channels (p. 2); no link or DOI for code or data, no public dataset, no measured data.
notes: The first page holds the title and DOI. Included in area 3: the DDPG actor outputs RSU beamformers and IRS phase shifts (p. 2) to maximize the minimum rate. The baselines of Fig. 3 are random IRS and MRT beamforming, both non-learned; the proposed method is itself DDPG, so q3 is 0. N=20 and N=30 appear as separate curves (p. 4); the paper does not say whether one trained model is reused. Frequency band not stated.
